title: Treatise of Fog and Tide United
summary: A treatise on uniting the mist stream with the water stream so that vapor and flood become one grey drowning tide.
notes: derived pair: Mist + Water as states of one substance (Fusion Law Area 2.2 Category A; not in Table 2.3)

title: Canon of Mist and Wind Woven
summary: A canon of weaving the mist stream into the wind stream so that haze rides a gale and the gale hides in haze.
notes: derived pair: Mist + Wind as atmospheric forces (Fusion Law Area 2.2 Category A; not in Table 2.3)
